# OJ Valeting

> Mobile car valeting and detailing by Owen, who comes to your home or place of work. Based between Brackley and Buckingham (MK18), covering Buckinghamshire, Northamptonshire, Oxfordshire, Bedfordshire and Warwickshire, and nationwide with a fuel charge further afield (about £10 for a job 45 minutes away). 5.0 from 13 Google reviews (November 2026). Fully insured. Phone 07708 600114. Call or text to book; online booking opens soon.

## What Owen does

Mobile valets, full deep cleans inside and out, machine polishing and paint correction, ceramic coating and maintenance plans, all done on the customer's drive or at their work. Cars, vans, motorbikes, caravans, motorhomes, horseboxes and farm vehicles are all welcome.

## Prices by vehicle size (small / medium / large / XL)

Owen confirms the final price after seeing the vehicle, before he starts. Small is roughly a Polo or Fiesta, medium a Golf or 3 Series, large an estate or SUV, XL a 7-seater, big 4x4 or van.

- [Basic package](/car-valeting/), inside and out: £45 / £55 / £65 / £75, 1 to 2 hours
- [Basic interior clean](/interior-valet/): from £30 / £35 / £40 / £45, about 1 hour
- [Basic exterior clean](/exterior-valet/): £25 / £35 / £40 / £45+, 1 to 2 hours
- [Full deep clean](/deep-clean/), inside and out: £150 / £165 / £180 / £200, 3 to 5 hours
- [Deep interior clean](/deep-interior/): from £130 / £140 / £150 / £155
- [Deep exterior clean](/deep-exterior/): £35 / £40 / £45 / £50
- [Paint correction](/paint-correction/), clay bar included: £210 / £230 / £250 / £270, 3 to 5 hours
- [Ceramic coating](/ceramic-coating/), 5 year: £300 / £340 / £380 / ask Owen. 3 year is £30 less, 7 year £80 more. If the paint needs correcting first, the correction comes at a discounted price when booked together.
- [Maintenance plan](/maintenance-valet/), every 2, 4 or 6 weeks: £40 / £50 / £60 / £70 a visit

Popular extras: ozone treatment £20, pet hair removal from £25, clay bar with full decontamination wash £50, headlight restoration from £75 a pair, interior leather ceramic coating from £120. Anything not listed: ask Owen.

## Payment and hours

- Payment: Apple Pay, bank transfer or cash on the day.
- Hours: Monday, Wednesday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday 8am to 6pm; Tuesday and Thursday 8am to 4pm.
